# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 2 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 37 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 17 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 9 tokens; Radius — 6 tokens; Shadow — 2 tokens; Blur — 3 tokens; Duration — 6 tokens; Easing — 4 tokens; Opacity — 2 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #1b1b20);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #ffffff);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #1b1b20;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #1b1b20 | #ffffff | Solid cards when Effects is Off; modal body base. |
| `--surface-hi` | rgba(255,255,255,0.10) | #ffffff | Selected segment in a segmented control; hovered tab. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--text, #f4efe6);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */

/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f4efe6;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--text` | #f4efe6 | #111114 | Body and headings on bg, surface and every glass. |
| `--text-muted` | #afaaa0 | #6b665c | Secondary text, labels, captions. Dark value lifted from #A8A399 so it passes 4.5:1 over the brightest glow. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--bg, #111114);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--bg, #f4efe6);

color: #111114;
```

### Tokens (17)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bg` | #111114 | #f4efe6 | Page background under the moving glow. Ink in dark, paper cream in light. |
| `--glass` | rgba(255,255,255,0.07) | rgba(255,255,255,0.60) | Tile fill. Always with backdrop blur (blur-full or blur-light). |
| `--glass-border` | rgba(255,255,255,0.13) | rgba(17,17,20,0.11) | Hairline around glass tiles, inputs at rest, table header rule. |
| `--glass-dense` | rgba(27,27,32,0.88) | rgba(255,255,255,0.88) | Tables, logs, config editor, modals: long text stays readable. |
| `--track` | rgba(255,255,255,0.09) | rgba(17,17,20,0.08) | Bar and ring tracks, skeleton base, neutral badges. |
| `--control-border` | #8c877d | #857f75 | Borders of inputs, off toggles, checkboxes, dashed add buttons. 3:1 against glass. |
| `--brand` | #ffb020 | #ffb020 | Saffron fill: primary buttons, active tab, logo doorway on This server and login. Text on it is ink. |
| `--brand-line` | #ffb020 | #b57a04 | Saffron for bars, sparklines, card edges, focus ring. 3:1 on cream and white. |
| `--brand-text` | #ffb020 | #906102 | Saffron used as text or icon on a plain ground. 4.5:1. |
| `--mint` | #34d399 | #34d399 | Secondary accent fill (third glow, highlights). Never for status text in light. |
| `--mint-text` | #34d399 | #047a55 | Mint as text. |
| `--success` | #34d399 | #047857 | Status: online, up, active. Always with an icon and a word. |
| `--success-text` | #34d399 | #047857 | Success word on glass. |
| `--warning` | #ff7a45 | #c2410c | Status: high load, expiring, slow. Orange-red so it never reads as saffron. |
| `--warning-text` | #fe8759 | #c2410c | Warning word on glass. Dark value lifted so it passes over a bright glow. Do not lighten the light value. |
| `--danger` | #f87171 | #b91c1c | Status: offline, down, expired, destructive. |
| `--danger-text` | #ff8482 | #b91c1c | Danger word on glass. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 750 34px/38px Manrope, Vazirmatn, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 34px / 38px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 750 | `sans` | Header greeting. Phone: 28px. |
| `kpi` | `.kpi`, `--text-kpi` | 40px / 40px, letter-spacing -0.03em | 750 | `sans` | Big live numbers. Always tabular figures. |
| `kpi-sm` | `.kpi-sm`, `--text-kpi-sm` | 28px / 30px | 750 | `sans` | Second number in a tile. |
| `h2` | `.h2`, `--text-h2` | 22px / 26px | 700 | `sans` | Section and page titles (page title 28px). |
| `h3` | `.h3`, `--text-h3` | 16px / 21px | 700 | `sans` | Card titles, row names. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 14px / 21px | 500 | `sans` | Default text. |
| `small` | `.small`, `--text-small` | 12.5px / 18px | 600 | `sans` | Secondary lines under a title, in text-muted. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 12px / 16px | 700 | `sans` | Tile titles, field labels, table headers. |
| `fa-display` | `.fa-display`, `--text-fa-display` | 34px / 44px | 750 | `fa` | Same sizes as Latin, line height about 15% taller, no letter spacing. |
| `fa-body` | `.fa-body`, `--text-fa-body` | 14px / 24px | 500 | `fa` | Persian body. |
| `code` | `.code`, `--text-code` | 12.5px / 22px | 400 | `mono` | Xray editor and logs only. Loads with those pages. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `Manrope, Vazirmatn, system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `fa` | `--font-fa` | `Vazirmatn, Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (9)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon to text inside pills and badges. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Between chips, tabs, small buttons. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Inside rows; row gap in lists. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Phone tile padding; grid gap on phones. |
| `--space-5` | 18px | Grid gap on laptop. |
| `--space-6` | 20px | Tile padding on laptop. |
| `--space-7` | 24px | Modal padding. |
| `--space-8` | 28px | Main area top padding. |
| `--space-9` | 36px | Main area side padding on laptop. |

/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--d-fast: 140ms) */

### Tokens (6)

| --- | --- | --- |
